A.summary: A is fully connected with a continuous main ground reference, closely bypassed loads, wide supply distribution and through-drilled vias. Resolve drill spacing, edge clearance, USB stackup and tight assembly envelopes before ordering.

B.summary: A compact crystal loop and well-coupled primary USB route sit on a sensible floorplan. Two shorts, including +1V2 to GND at C14, and 15 missing connections block power-up.

C.summary: C connects the circuit and matches the expansion pairs closely, but inner-layer signal routing interrupts return paths and the +5V feed is long and narrow. Its 113 laser microvias, 44 buried vias and stacked drill locations require an HDI process.

D.summary: D has 321 missing connections across 138 nets, including the main and bank supplies, crystal and interface clocks. Long USB probe branches and distant FPGA decoupling compound the incomplete routing.

human_guess.why: A uses wide local copper for regulators and shunts, puts individual bypass capacitors behind switching loads, integrates USB probe pads into crossover vias, and tunes the expansion lanes on a through-drilled board. That combination of circuit-specific decisions is the strongest evidence of human authorship.
